newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-North Flinders Q1 net profit falls.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-North Flinders Q1 net profit falls.

text.p: North Flinders Mines Ltd said on Thursday that unaudited net profit in the first quarter ended September 30 fell to A$7.09 million from A$7.99 million a year earlier.
The latest quarterly result compared with a net profit of A$7.30 million in the 1995/96 fourth quarter.

The company, which is subject to a takeover bid by Normandy Mining Ltd, said gold sales fell in the latest period compared with the fourth quarter, as did the average realised price. Normandy has 73.7 percent of North Flinders' issued capital. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 373-1800
